description: This file defines a React context provider component (AppStateProvider) for managing shared application state in a frontend app, specifically for a weekly status report generator. It manages uploaded files, normalized tasks, rules, report preview data, loading/error states, and provides functions for parsing files, updating rules, generating previews, and exporting reports. The file references external service functions for report processing and uses React hooks for state management.

classes.name: AppStateProvider
classes.description: A React component that provides shared application state related to file uploads, task normalization, rules, report previews, and report exporting functionalities using React Context API.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses selected files to normalized task rows and updates the report preview based on current rules.

methods.name: updateRules
methods.description: Merges partial rule updates into current rules and regenerates the report preview if tasks are available.

methods.name: generatePreview
methods.description: Recomputes the report preview data based on normalized tasks and current rules.

methods.name: exportExcel
methods.description: Triggers report export using current preview data and returns a downloadable URL or null if export fails.
